subset.rationale: The BINDER-0008 payoff: absl::flat_hash_map/flat_hash_set/node_hash_map bound HEAD-ON. Reachability discovery (binder Change 1) keeps the container_internal policy explosion out (no FlatHashMapPolicy/Hash/Eq/Alloc types; only signature-reachable internals like node_handle and the raw_hash_map/raw_hash_set ancestry, which becomes the Python base chain). Default-instantiable member templates (binder Change 2 + the TC-0004 dispatch-level substitution workaround) bind the heterogeneous query surface directly: contains/count/find/erase/at/equal_range and operator[] -> __getitem__ (C++ semantics: default-inserts on miss). size/empty/clear/capacity/bucket_count/load_factor/rehash/reserve bind as plain methods. The hmtest fixture supplies only VALUE-SETTING population (put/add): insert()'s pair<iterator,bool> return has no Python representation (iterators are C++-only), and __getitem__ cannot express assignment.
skipped_features: insert/extract from Python (returns pair<iterator,bool>/node_handle; iterator types have no Python value semantics -- population via hmtest::put/add or d[k] default-insert)
FixedArray (still blocked -- internal AsValueType instantiation; see BINDER-0008)
